headline: Ingenia Communities Shares Rally on $1.5 Billion Buyout Offer From AVID
summary: Shares of Ingenia Communities rose following a $1.5 billion buyout offer from AVID Property Group.
why: Ingenia Communities is an Australian real estate investment trust focused on lifestyle communities and holiday parks.

impacts.name: Ingenia Communities Group
impacts.why: Target stock surged after receiving a $1.5 billion acquisition bid from AVID.

why_moved: Ingenia Communities shares rallied after receiving a $1.5 billion takeover proposal from AVID Property Group.
